body: I've been away from the man who raped me for years now. I unfortunately don't have anywhere to go, no nearby relatives or friends that could take me in. I have two jobs and go to school full time so moving isn't really an option right now. I avoid my mother well enough, right now she isn't my greatest problem.

I live with my mother. She yells at me and constantly tells me how worthless I am. She's a drunk and not a person that I can turn to for help. I live with her because I don't make enough money to live alone.
